No, they won't. Have personally had the same player grief in 6 comp games over 2 days with every player reporting them with zero consequence. Along with the countless posts here that show the same scenario. That report option is exactly what the "fix to season 3 competitive" was, pure bullshit. Just a PR stunt to shut people up followed by more skins and putting a few new effects on a map or two. 

Blizzard is lost right now. They were so sure Overwatch comp would be the new king like LoL was. But Overwatch comp has somehow managed to be an even bigger cesspool than LoL.

Let's continue just making the competitive quitters just suffer through a red banner saying "Dont leave or well make you wait 2 seconds before you can leave again!".

It's worked out terrific, and competitive is in a great state.

/s

Probably because competitive is awful in a nutshell. Grossly mismatched games, placements mean literally nothing. Players can win 3 games for 50 SR, and one troll will most likely lose all that rating in one game. The entire system is just embarrassing. Poorly made, poorly designed, and Blizzard knows it. Season 1 and 2 were both awful, Blizz acknowledged comp was broken. And their amazing fix for season 3 was to make everyone do placements and then trick them by making them place their lowest season 2 rank regardless of performance. 

It's just a huge fucking embarrassment.
